nonblocking_findings.description: The prompt is built with a blanket `TEMPLATE.read_text().replace('attempt-01', stem)`. Template line 3 ('attempt-01.source.json and attempt-01.checks.json') must be rewritten to the current attempt, but template line 19 ('inspect the retained independent documentation attempt-01.json and attempt-01.disposition.json') refers to the PRIOR retained review and must not be. The recorded prompt at docs/reviews/github-pages/release-0.2.4/attempt-02.prompt.md:19 therefore instructs this attempt to inspect attempt-02.json and attempt-02.disposition.json, which cannot exist (attempt-02.json is written only after the review returns; only attempt-01.json and attempt-01.disposition.json exist in SCOPE). A reviewer following the prompt literally never reaches the prior review's findings or its correction record, which defeats the stated purpose of the follow-up attempt, and the defect recurs identically for attempts 3-5.
nonblocking_findings.required_fix: Replace the blanket substitution with targeted placeholders: put '{current}' and '{prior}' in docs-site/scripts/review-release-024.prompt.md and format them with f'attempt-{args.attempt:02d}' and f'attempt-{args.attempt-1:02d}' respectively (omitting the follow-up paragraph when attempt == 1), and add a unit case in docs-site/scripts/test_review_release_024.py asserting that the rendered prompt for attempt 2 names attempt-02.source.json/checks.json and attempt-01.json/attempt-01.disposition.json.

nonblocking_findings.description: REFERENCES hardcodes 'docs/reviews/github-pages/release-0.2.4/attempt-01.disposition.json'. The prior-attempt disposition is therefore bound into snapshot()'s source fingerprint only for attempt 2; on attempts 3-5 the then-current prior disposition (attempt-02.disposition.json and later) is neither bound in the source manifest nor guaranteed present, so the record the reviewer is asked to confirm fixes against is unprotected against mid-review change.
nonblocking_findings.required_fix: Derive the prior-disposition reference from the attempt number (e.g. append f'docs/reviews/github-pages/release-0.2.4/attempt-{attempt-1:02d}.disposition.json' to the reference set when attempt > 1 and the file exists) so each attempt's manifest binds the disposition it is reviewing.

nonblocking_findings.description: After the attempt-01 fix, ci_receipt is validated with .get() plus a named ValueError, but neighbouring lookups still index directly: delivery_records() uses status['phases'] (line 72) and verify_release_delivery() uses registry['sourceCommit'] (line 152) and verified['sourceCommit']/['ciCommit'] (line 154). These run before the inner try at line 378 that catches KeyError, and the outer handler at line 438 catches only (ValueError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError), so a malformed phase-status.json or guard stdout aborts the runner with a traceback instead of the intended single-line failure message.
nonblocking_findings.required_fix: Read 'phases', 'sourceCommit' and 'ciCommit' with .get(), raise ValueError naming the failing predicate when absent or malformed, and add a regression case for a phase-status.json without 'phases' and for guard stdout missing sourceCommit/ciCommit.

nonblocking_findings.description: The new 0.2.4 entry (line 10) is pinned to the published release commit 6f18529a47cc273feca1000af6e4fc0d96da757e, while every sibling example on this page (lines 9 and 11-21) remains pinned to the pre-0.2.4 content-source commit efe9de04d9f60d48e6ba8528d1a07e86376d706d. The page presents all of them as 'included with the crate source' for the current 0.2.4 release, and docs/checks/release-registry-0.2.4.json:57-126 shows these example files shipping in the 0.2.4 archive, so readers following the older links may see sources that differ from the release they installed without any label saying the link is a historical content snapshot.
nonblocking_findings.required_fix: Either repoint the example permalinks on docs-site/docs/developer/examples.md:9,11-21 to 6f18529a47cc273feca1000af6e4fc0d96da757e, or state once on the page that non-0.2.4 entries are pinned to the DESIGN_SOURCE contentSourceCommit snapshot (docs-site/DESIGN_SOURCE.json:12) and are not the released 0.2.4 file state.
